name: image-editing
description: Curate, report on, and non-generatively edit food images with ranked visual evidence, measurable corrections, layered compositing, and previewed color-derived masks.

interface.shortDescription: Review and technically edit food images.
interface.longDescription: Inspects and ranks food photographs, produces linked main and per-dish HTML curation reports, measures tone and color, reviews angle and composition, and applies bounded source-derived corrections through previewed geometric or color-similarity masks. It never generates, clones, replaces, or reconstructs scene content.
defaultPrompt: Onboard me to Food Image Editing without editing yet.
Preview a color-derived mask for this food image.
Curate this food shoot and create linked main and per-dish HTML reports.
